bibl.title: I papiri ritrovati a Pompei: qualche aggiornamento.
bibl.seg: Gianluca Del Mastro, I papiri ritrovati a Pompei: qualche aggiornamento.
bibl.note: Discusses some documents concerning the discovery of papyrus in Pompeii. In this area, as is known, the different type of carbonization of plant materials did not allow the finding of papyri. For the first time, some fragments of a small Latin papyrus, found during the excavations in the Regio I, are presented: it could have been an amulet or a malediction.
